title: Escalation Routing Rule R-009: Critical lab result unalerted
content:
ROUTING RULE: R-009 -- Critical lab result unalerted
TRIGGER TYPE: Data State
CONDITION: critical_value_flag TRUE but doctor_alerted FALSE
ROUTE TO: Clinical Review (Extension 1012)
QUEUE: QUEUE_CLINICAL
PRIORITY: URGENT
SLA: 0.5 hour(s)
ESCALATION RATIONALE: Severe patient safety hazard. Mandatory verbal readback within 15 minutes of critical result. Contact Clinical Review ext. 1012.
EXAMPLE QUERY 1: Potassium 6.8 mmol/L but doctor not alerted for 30m
EXAMPLE QUERY 2: Platelets under 20000 with alert unexecuted
